bio: This pleasantly down-to-earth restaurant is the second in the cube-like extension of the Leineschloss, along with Votum. The flavoursome food is made with select ingredients and draws on French influences. The fish soup or the pulpo salad are tasty, for example. They also serve a simpler quick lunch set menu. Delightful terraces at the Leinewehr and on Platz der Göttinger Sieben....
